verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure almost exactly for a nearly identical aspect ratio, which is correct here. Brand, headline, subcopy, pills and CTA are well spaced and aligned on the left axis. Its flaws are minor: the yellow circle now grows behind the headline and subcopy, and the pill labels and legal line stay tiny. B rebuilds the layout and breaks it. The headline is blown up into a three-line block jammed against the left and top edges. The CTA is oversized and competes with the headline. The subcopy sits above the CTA, so the reading order goes wrong. The pills are reshuffled, leaving BLOOD ORANGE alone on its own row, and the right column is cramped onto the pink circle with almost no margin.
